blocks.text: A media query chooses styles for certain screen sizes. Less can place it inside the component rule and build normal CSS.
Use Less 4 on your computer. Install Node.js first. Save examples as lesson.less, then run npx lessc lesson.less lesson.css. The browser loads lesson.css; this site does not build Less.

blocks.title: Combine a card and a screen rule

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: A media query only applies its enclosed styles when the stated condition matches. The other styles remain the starting rules.

blocks.text: Cards get more inner space when the viewport is 640px wide or wider.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Test the final CSS in the browser. Less does not choose a screen size while compiling.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Set the larger padding to 20px and check both layouts.
